reasoning_content: Now I know the correct registration fields: name, email, password, confirmPassword, confirmationLink, lang. Login uses email + password. Let me redo the flow.

action.command:
TS="tsv2$(date +%s)"; EMAIL="$TS@example.com"; echo "=== REGISTER ==="; curl -s -w "
[HTTP %{http_code}]
" -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/users/register -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{"name":"$TS","email":"$EMAIL","password":"Test1234!","confirmPassword":"Test1234!","confirmationLink":"http://localhost:3000/confirm","lang":"en"}"; echo "=== LOGIN (email) ==="; curl -s -c /tmp/ts-cookies.txt -w "
[HTTP %{http_code}]
" -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/users/login -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{"email":"$EMAIL","password":"Test1234!"}"; echo "=== AUTH HEALTH ==="; curl -s -b /tmp/ts-cookies.txt -w "
[HTTP %{http_code}]
" http://localhost:8000/api/health; echo "=== USER SETTINGS (authed) ==="; curl -s -b /tmp/ts-cookies.txt -w "
[HTTP %{http_code}]
" http://localhost:8000/api/users/user-settings
